mechanism: Before an EKF exists, launch-cue residuals were only soft score penalties. A close, high-SNR neighboring ASM reflector could dominate the score and initialize the seeker EKF away from the designated target basket.
runtimeEvidence: All 37 stored TRACK-C qualified-egress samples first associated and first confirmed TRACK on an RF_OBJECT. A same-tick surface-target return was present in representative samples. No damage preceded the first confirmed TRACK.
caveat: Fresh replay reproduced the stored final egress endpoint in 12 of 37 samples; diagnostic observer ON/OFF remained byte-identical. Root-cause classification uses the common first-association path, not endpoint equality.
